payment: by cheque to the Receiver General, direct deposit or wire transfer to the Receiver General's account, or card: “Clients may remit their fee payment by cheque, credit card or electronically” … “Your invoice or statement remittance stub should be enclosed with your payment.”
period: a yearly fee invoiced before each licence anniversary: “Every year before the licence anniversary date, the Commission shall issue to the licensee an invoice for the annual fee payable.”
delivery: an invoice every year: “Every year before the licence anniversary date, the Commission shall issue to the licensee an invoice for the annual fee payable.”
terms: “The licensee shall pay the fee to the Commission by the later of 30 days after the date of the invoice and the licence anniversary date.”
remit_to: “Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission 280 Slater Street P.O. Box 1046, STN B Ottawa ON K1P 5S9 Canada”
